title: HeRE: A Novel Benchmark for Hebrew Relation Extraction via LLM-Guided Denoising of Knowledge Graph Alignments
abstract: arXiv:2610.22542v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: While LLMs demonstrate strong capabilities in English Relation Extraction (RE) tasks, a significant gap remains in assessing their RE performance in low-resource languages, due to a lack of standardized benchmarks. Creating native, language-specific annotated RE benchmarks is expensive and requires human expertise, while relying on translation yields suboptimal, inaccurate datasets that introduce English-centric biases. To tackle this, we propose a scalable, language-agnostic methodology to create RE data by denoising naturally occurring yet noisy alignments of knowledge bases and corresponding texts. We define a proper alignment via a Natural Language Inference (NLI) task, where a relation triplet is entailed by an input text. We empirically assess five denoising strategies, and demonstrate that multilingual models outperform language-specific models in the few-shot LLM setting, while Hebrew-specific encoders remain competitive under NL

translated_title: HeRE：通过大语言模型引导的知识图谱对齐去噪构建的希伯来语关系抽取新基准
translated_abstract: 尽管大语言模型在英语关系抽取任务中展现出强大的能力，但由于缺乏标准化基准，评估其在低资源语言中的关系抽取性能仍存在显著差距。创建原生的、针对特定语言标注的关系抽取基准成本高昂且需要人工专业知识，而依赖翻译则会产生次优、不准确的数据集，并引入以英语为中心的偏差。为解决这一问题，我们提出了一种可扩展的、语言无关的方法论，通过对知识库与相应文本之间自然存在但含噪的对齐进行去噪来创建关系抽取数据。我们通过自然语言推理（NLI）任务定义了恰当的对齐，即一个关系三元组需被输入文本所蕴含。我们对五种去噪策略进行了实证评估，并证明在少样本LLM设置下，多语言模型优于特定语言模型，而希伯来语专用编码器在NLI设置下仍具有竞争力。
tldr: 本文提出HeRE——首个基于LLM引导去噪知识图谱对齐构建的希伯来语关系抽取基准，提供了一种可扩展、语言无关的低资源语言关系抽取数据集创建方法。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces HeRE, a novel benchmark for Hebrew Relation Extraction built via LLM-guided denoising of knowledge graph-text alignments, offering a scalable and language-agnostic methodology for creating RE datasets in low-resource languages.
